description: A new built from ground up Polymer and Lootr connector to make Lootr work server-side only with polymer.

mods.name: PolyLootr
mods.description: Server-side wrapper that lets vanilla Minecraft clients connect to a Lootr server. Lootr's modded blocks, items, and entities are translated to their nearest vanilla equivalents via Polymer; per-player particles indicate unlooted containers.
